method: 2026-10-31 cross-repository W0X rewrite. One record per row of this spec: action, decisions, retirement reason, new children, rows requested in other specs, cross edits requested of other rows, and harness consumer notes. Rules: one row standard, production caller chain, served proof, both sides declared, knobs, ecosystem boundaries.

cross_edits_requested.change: State that a changeset is the payload of a branch commit of EG-BRANCH-MERGE-R002 and defines no second chain.

decisions: One commit chain: branch commits own the chain, a source changeset is a payload; merge-base picks highest generation number then smallest id.
File line merge for source changesets is a separate row (NEW:2) so SCM-R003 can reuse it.
Conflict winner is a Decide family (NEW:1): score = reliability x confidence, margin knob 0.15, abstain otherwise.
